baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the MOSIP deployment (api gateway / partner endpoint).

clientId.title: Partner Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth2 / partner client id. Issued during the partner onboarding flow.

appId.title: App ID
appId.description: MOSIP app id (e.g. `IDA`, `PARTNER`) — identifies which client app is calling.

webSubHubUrl.title: WebSub Hub URL
webSubHubUrl.description: Optional. WebSub hub endpoint to subscribe to (for credential / UIN / VID events). Required only if your workflow consumes MOSIP WebSub events.

partnerPrivateKeyPath.title: Partner Private Key (PEM)
partnerPrivateKeyPath.description: Partner private key used to sign requests and decrypt DataShare URLs.
